questions.question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

This book provides an __unrestrained__ account of the natural resources in India.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: **exhaustive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"unrestrained"** means something that is not controlled or limited; it can refer to actions or descriptions that are free and unrestricted. (अप्रतिबंधित)

 
 
• **Example: **His unrestrained laughter filled the room with joy.
 
 
 
• **"Exhaustive"** refers to something that is thorough and complete, covering all possible aspects or elements. (व्यापक)
 
 
• **Example: **The report provided an exhaustive analysis of the market trends over the last decade.
 
 
 
• Hence, using the word **'exhaustive'** in place of 'unrestrained' makes the sentence more accurate in context.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **exhaustive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Limited** (सीमित): Something that is restricted in size, amount, or extent.

 
 
• **Example:** The resources available for the project were quite limited.
 
 
 
• **Excessive** (अत्यधिक): More than necessary, normal, or desirable; immoderate.
 
 
• **Example:** The excessive use of plastic is harming the environment.
 
 
 
• **Exhausting** (थकाऊ): Making one feel very tired; very tiring.
 
 
• **Example:** The exhausting hike left everyone feeling drained.

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Reconnoitre
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Inspect'.

***__Key Points__** 

 
• Reconnoitre is a verb which means to make a military observation of (a region).

 
 
• Example - *They **reconnoitred **the beach some weeks before the landing.*
 
 
 
• The meaning of the given options are as follows - 
 
 
• Glance - take a brief or hurried look. - Shiela **glanced **at the clock.*
 
• Disclaim - refuse to acknowledge; deny. -* The school **disclaimed **any responsibility for his death.*
 
• Inspect - look at (someone or something) closely, typically to assess their condition or to discover any shortcomings. - *Customs officers came aboard to **inspect **our documents.*
 
• Overlook - fail to notice. - *He **overlooked **her many transgressions.*
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is evident that inspect is the correct synonym for the word **reconnoitre**.
 
• Hence, option 3 is the correct answer.
